outcome: Number of patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA) compressions
cohort: 160 women undergoing elective second cesarean section
finding: A single intravenous injection of nalbuphine 20 mg 10 minutes before the infusion of oxytocin combined with sufentanil 2 µg/kg could be safely used for postoperative analgesia in patients undergoing a second cesarean section and could effectively inhibit uterine contractions induced by oxytocin and reduce adverse reactions.
